args.sql:
WITH health_resilience_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        distregistry AS registry_id,
        (
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN "medicalEmergencyCapacity" = 'Adequate' THEN 1.0
                    WHEN "medicalEmergencyCapacity" = 'Limited' THEN 0.6
                    WHEN "medicalEmergencyCapacity" = 'Critical' THEN 0.3
                    ELSE 0.0
                END
            ) * (
                CASE 
                    WHEN "hazlevel" = 'Level 1' THEN 5
                    WHEN "hazlevel" = 'Level 2' THEN 4
                    WHEN "hazlevel" = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                    WHEN "hazlevel" = 'Level 4' THEN 2
                    WHEN "hazlevel" = 'Level 5' THEN 1
                END
            ) * (
                1 - (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN "hazlevel" = 'Level 1' THEN 1
                        WHEN "hazlevel" = 'Level 2' THEN 2
                        WHEN "hazlevel" = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                        WHEN "hazlevel" = 'Level 4' THEN 4
                        WHEN "hazlevel" = 'Level 5' THEN 5
                    END / 6.0
                )
            )
        ) AS health_resilience_score,
        (
            ("diseaserisk" = 'High') AND (waterqualityindex < 50) AND (PHRS < 40)
        ) AS is_public_health_emergency,
        (
            ("diseaserisk" = 'High') 
            AND (waterqualityindex < 50) 
            AND (PHRS < 40)
            AND (health_resilience_score < 30)
            AND (staffingProfile->>'ppe_status' = 'Critical')
        ) AS is_critical_health_response_required
    FROM 
        "environmentandhealth" AS eh
    INNER JOIN disasterevents AS de ON de.distregistry = eh.envdistref
)
SELECT 
    registry_id,
    health_resilience_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN is_critical_health_response_required THEN 'Health Crisis'
        ELSE 'Normal Health Status'
    END AS health_status
FROM 
    health_resilience_scores
ORDER BY 
    registry_id;

                    WHEN eh.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Adequate' THEN 1.0
                    WHEN eh.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Limited' THEN 0.6
                    WHEN eh.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Critical' THEN 0.3
                    ELSE 0.0
                END
            ) * (
                CASE 
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 1' THEN 5
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 2' THEN 4
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 4' THEN 2
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 5' THEN 1
                END
            ) * (
                1 - (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 1' THEN 1
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 2' THEN 2
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 4' THEN 4
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 5' THEN 5
                    END / 6.0
                )
            )
        ) AS health_resilience_score,
        (
            (eh.diseaserisk = 'High') AND (eh.waterqualityindex < 50) AND (PHRS < 40)
        ) AS is_public_health_emergency,
        (
            (eh.diseaserisk = 'High') 
            AND (eh.waterqualityindex < 50) 
            AND (PHRS < 40)
            AND (health_resilience_score < 30)
            AND (staffingProfile->>'ppe_status' = 'Critical')
        ) AS is_critical_health_response_required
    FROM 
        "environmentandhealth" AS eh
    INNER JOIN disasterevents AS de ON de.distregistry = eh.envdistref
)
SELECT 
    registry_id,
    health_resilience_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN is_critical_health_response_required THEN 'Health Crisis'
        ELSE 'Normal Health Status'
    END AS health_status
FROM 
    health_resilience_scores
ORDER BY 
    registry_id;
